stories.headline: FinWise Owns Full Card Tech Stack After Acquiring Tallied Platform
stories.body: FinWise Bancorp, the parent company of FinWise Bank, has brought card issuing and processing in-house by acquiring the technology platform and related assets of Tallied Technologies, FinWise said in a Monday (July 20) press release. stories.headline: Jamie Dimon says markets underestimate risks and he wouldn't buy stocks or Treasurys at current prices
stories.body: Comments from JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon contrast with investors' recent willingness to look past wars, tariffs and other shocks.
